title: the Notebook column hugs the left edge on tablet
observed: At 0aa8ebcf the 720px-capped column (Design.tao:57 `column [width max 720, gap 16]`) sits at the left of the 1024px tablet viewport, leaving about 270px of empty canvas on the right while the header spans the full width.
impact: The tablet layout reads as unfinished; whether a capped column should center is a design call.
expected: The Developer decides whether the starter column centers at widths above its cap.
recheck: recapture devices/tabletDark after the decision and inspect horizontal placement.
notes: Developer decided 2026-10-02 to center the capped column; Notebook, Pantry and the creation template now use `column [width max 720, gap 16, centered]`. A local capture showed the tablet column centered; the tall new-note card is QA-NOTEBOOK-PANEL-STRETCH.
